enforced.pageSpecTokenOverrides: NONE EXIST. The PageSpec schema has no style or token field: styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts. There is therefore nothing token-related to validate at the PageSpec layer (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21); token drift is checked at the catalog layer by verify_all.py.

convention.referenceSemanticFirst: Contracts reference color-roles.* / typography-roles.* before foundation values.
convention.noNewColours: No colour outside tokens/00-foundation/color.json (the measured histogram contains nothing else).
